
---

### Downloads

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **macOS** (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Reaper-Mesh-macOS.dmg` |
| **Windows** (64-bit) | `Reaper-Mesh-Windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| **Linux** (x86-64) | `Reaper-Mesh-Linux-x86_64.AppImage` or `Reaper-Mesh-Linux-amd64.deb` |
| **Firmware** | One zip per board. Most people install firmware from the [browser installer](https://reapermesh.com/flash/) or the desktop app instead |

`SHA256SUMS` lists every file's hash. It detects corruption, not a malicious publisher: releases are
not signed yet, so macOS and Windows ask you to allow the app the first time you open it. See the
[desktop app guide](https://github.com/justingreerbbi/reaper-mesh/blob/main/docs/guides/desktop-app.md).
